blocks.x: And I finally started going to work down at the -- I think -- what was the -- it was either Birdland or the -- Birdland, I guess.
Birdland was open -- no, I think it was a little before '50. Let's see.
Well, I did work Bop City. I worked Bop City with Slam, and --
Birdland was after that, yeah. I worked Bop City with -- And before Bop City was the Royal Roost.
